newsitem.title: INDIA: India Finolex group copper plant to start in Oct.
newsitem.headline: India Finolex group copper plant to start in Oct.

text.p: Finolex Essex Industries Ltd, part of India's Finolex Group, will start commercial production at its copper cathode plant in October, the Finolex Group chairman told Reuters on Monday.
"The copper cathode plant which is a joint venture of Finolex and Essex Industries of the U.S. will commence production in October 1997," Pralhad Chhabria said in an interview.
The joint venture is equally owned by the Finolex Group and the U.S. firm. It has a capital base of 450 million rupees, he said.
In the first phase, the plant in the western city of Goa, will produce 60,000 tonnes a year of copper cathodes. A second phase will see the capacity rising to 80,000 tonnes, he said.
"We will also expand into fine and superfine magnet wire production," Chhabria said.
The Finolex Group has interests in the manufacture of PVC resin, irrigation pipe and drip irrigation systems and telecommunication cables.
The group is headquartered in the western city of Pune.
